items.name: Pet Adoption
items.short_description: REST API built with NestJS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to manage the complete pet adoption lifecycle, with secure authentication, Domain Events, and extensive automated test coverage.
items.description: Backend developed with a focus on scalability, code quality, and enterprise architecture. The application follows Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Clean Architecture principles, keeping the domain fully decoupled from infrastructure. It includes JWT RS256 authentication via HTTP-Only Cookies, policy-based authorization, Domain Events for business rule communication, and a robust automated testing strategy.
features: Shelter unit registration and management
Pet management with image upload via Multer
Complete adoption flow with multiple statuses
Candidate system with policy-driven business validations
JWT RS256 authentication via HTTP-Only Cookies
Role-based authorization (ADMIN and ADOPTER)
Policy Runner for centralized authorization rules
Domain Events for traceability and business rule decoupling
Typed environment variable validation using Zod
Decoupled repositories through contracts and interfaces
95 automated unit tests
91 automated End-to-End (E2E) tests
Isolated database schema for safe E2E test execution
Architecture designed for long-term scalability and maintainability
items.differential: Project built using strategic and tactical DDD, Clean Architecture, and Domain Events, keeping business rules independent of NestJS, Prisma, or any infrastructure technology. Features 95 unit tests and 91 E2E automated tests, ensuring high reliability and ease of evolution.

items.name: Pratique Chat
items.short_description: In-house multichannel support platform, unifying WhatsApp (Meta API), Instagram, Facebook, and in-app chats into a single dashboard, with dedicated sales and cancellation AIs.
items.description: Pratique Fitness' in-house support hub, with a customized frontend. It unifies 20+ customer communication channels — via the official Meta API (WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook), the chats linked directly to the Pratique app, and other channels — into a single dashboard for support agents. It runs several specialized AIs working alongside the human team, including the sales AI 'Paty', which talks to leads via text, audio, and images, applies re-engagement flows for inactive customers, and hands off to a human agent when needed. Already in production for the 170+ gym network and under constant evolution.
features: 20+ communication channels unified in one place: via API, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and more
Also connects the chats linked directly to the Pratique app
Fully in-house, customized frontend for the entire support operation
Agent, template, and contact management
Sales AI 'Paty': chats via text, sends and interprets audio and photos, sells and cancels plans
Automatic handoff from AI to human agent when needed
Re-engagement flow for inactive customers, with automatic link sending
Lead classification and AI-generated sales report by affiliate
Dedicated cancellation AI flow
Ongoing maintenance: building the AIs, configuring Meta numbers, and bug fixing
items.differential: A fully in-house, proprietary platform, evolved with specialized AIs, automatic re-engagement flows, and 20+ unified communication channels — drastically reducing the need for human support without losing quality. Actively used by the 170+ gym network and under constant evolution.
